comparison.objective: Transfer support of a gravity-loaded cover and close it at a controlled speed.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold a moving cover, hand off support between hands, withdraw safely, and regulate closure.
comparison.success_condition: Cover closes within an observable speed constraint; the record supplies no numeric speed threshold and infers no injury or damage.
comparison.reason: This tests support transfer and velocity-controlled closure, not fine tool/collar manipulation or iterative damper tuning.
